build_gtn_graph: build a weighted finite state transducer graph using gtn.Graph with add_node and add_arc
test_forward_score: test the forward_score function to compute the log-sum-exp score of all paths in a GTN graph
test_viterbi_path: test the viterbi_path function to find the highest scoring path through a GTN graph
compose_gtn_graphs: compose two GTN graphs using gtn.compose to chain transducer operations together
remove_epsilon_arcs: remove epsilon transitions from a GTN graph using gtn.remove to simplify the automaton
